ai_review.summary: Recording is marred by tape damage, leaving the performance details unclear.
ai_review.review: The sole review points out significant tape wear that cuts into the beginning of "Rider," despite the recording equipment being top‑notch. No musical commentary is provided, so the show's quality cannot be assessed beyond the damaged audio.
